latest_substantive_result.scope: For rank-m full spectral range with maximum row leverage delta, a floating half-paving gives error sqrt(m(m+1)/8) delta; combined with the completed fractional cross-block inequality this yields a bounded continuous density whenever alpha=1/2-sqrt(m(m+1)/8)delta>0 and some 1<=q<3/2 satisfies 2delta/alpha<=q. In rank 4 at delta=1/8 the density bound is <19.072 uniformly in an arbitrarily small fourth nonzero eigenvalue.
